review_surface.first_path: Dazhongsi interchange -> accessible ground route -> AI Origin Community service desk

resource_units.non_ai_equivalent: posted route, staffed wayfinding and public transport
resource_units.refusal_condition: any route segment or staffed fallback is unverified
resource_units.writeback: freeze reservation and return to P0 inventory

resource_units.non_ai_equivalent: published timetable, platform information and staffed transfer desk
resource_units.refusal_condition: capacity, timetable or transfer responsibility is unknown
resource_units.writeback: remove feeder demand from the pilot and keep public transport priority

resource_units.non_ai_equivalent: paper booking register and on-site marshal
denominator: fire and accessible route minutes protected
resource_units.refusal_condition: a booking would displace a public, fire or accessible route
resource_units.writeback: reject the request and retain the public route

resource_units.recipient_role: community liaison and resident/carer observation roles
resource_units.refusal_condition: the digital option is required for basic access or a group loses an alternative
resource_units.writeback: disable the digital recommendation and keep the human route open

resource_units.non_ai_equivalent: manual inspection, repair ticket and removable sign or barrier
resource_units.refusal_condition: no named maintenance role or no removal path exists
resource_units.writeback: remove the temporary asset and return the location to the last safe state

resource_units.recipient_role: data stewardship and independent privacy review roles
resource_units.non_ai_equivalent: aggregate paper register with a public complaint channel
resource_units.refusal_condition: personal trajectory, unclear purpose or ownerless complaint is requested
resource_units.writeback: stop collection, delete or quarantine the record, and reopen the complaint

resource_units.recipient_role: independent safety, accessibility, privacy and equity review roles
resource_units.non_ai_equivalent: public notice, staffed observation and group-specific manual review
resource_units.refusal_condition: only average performance is available or negative cases are excluded
resource_units.writeback: hold expansion and publish an aggregate correction or withdrawal record

offline_evidence.next_action: collect dated local denominators before any P1 acceptance

boundary: This contract makes resource burden and refusal visible. It does not prove staffing, capacity, accessibility performance, public acceptance, safety, funding, permission or operation.
